checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
The includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
No other mandatory staff, facilities or overhead fee appears besides the basic services fee.
D-embalming and the $795 embalming price are both on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral.
D-alt-container and the direct cremation range are both on page 2, so same-page placement counts as correct.
Direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container and alternative container options; no text says a casket is required.
The list gives direct cremation prices but is silent on whether the crematory fee is included or a cash advance.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no goods or services appear only inside a package or description.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are required items, not packages.
No text asserts a purchase is required by law, cemetery or crematory beyond the prescribed disclosure wording.
No claims about delaying decomposition or protecting the body from gravesite substances appear.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no disclosure is shown as hard to notice.
